title: Three-Fold Composition of Linear and Quadratic Functions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Write a simplified formula for the three-fold composition (f o g o h)(x), given f(x) = 3x + 4, g(x) = 2x - 1, and h(x) = x^2.

steps.title: Express the Three-Fold Composition in Nested Form
steps.explanation: Write the composite function as nested evaluations starting from the innermost function h(x) = x^2.

steps.title: Evaluate the Inner Composition g(h(x))
steps.explanation: Substitute h(x) = x^2 for x in g(x) = 2x - 1.
steps.why: Symbolic substitution of the inner function into the middle function.

steps.title: Evaluate the Outer Composition f(g(h(x)))
steps.explanation: Substitute 2x^2 - 1 for x in f(x) = 3x + 4, distribute 3, and combine the constants -3 and 4.
steps.why: Distributing and collecting like terms simplifies the polynomial composition.
